source_quote: Academic Coordinator: Najwa Saba ‘Ayon Fares Mahmoud
answer: The Languages and Liberal Arts Unit (LLA) academic coordinator is Professor Najwa Saba 'Ayon Fares Mahmoud; full-time faculty include Associate Professor Grasiella Harb, Assistant Professors Maysaa Banat and Naziha Shamseddine, and Senior Lecturer Dina Baba.

source_quote: The Languages and Liberal Arts Unit offers an undergraduate program leading to a
answer: The LLA Unit offers the BA in English Language, minors in English Language and Literature and in Psychology, and provides the Intensive Language Program and core education courses to all RHU students.

source_quote: The main goal of the Bachelor of Arts in English Language Program is to prepare
answer: The BA in English Language prepares students with linguistic, literary, fiction/non-fiction writing and intercultural backgrounds for careers and graduate work, developing critical thinking, collaboration, research and literacy skills.

source_quote: Identify different subfields in linguistics;
answer: English Language graduates should be able to identify linguistics subfields, use linguistic and literary terminology, differentiate linguistic theories, analyze literary texts, communicate across cultures, synthesize information, conduct English language research, and take up a language profession.

source_quote: English Language graduates may become English teachers, editors,
answer: English Language graduates work in schools, translation firms, publishing houses, PR firms, NGOs and media as teachers, editors, journalists, PR practitioners, writers and translators; many pursue graduate studies in linguistics, education, literature or communication.

source_quote: To obtain a Bachelor of Arts degree in English Language, the student must complete 93
answer: The BA in English Language requires 93 credit hours covering University, College and Program requirements, planned over six semesters and two summer sessions.

answer: English Language mandatory courses: ENGL 222, ENGL 250, ENGL 251, ENGL 342, ENGL 350, ENGL 360, ENGL 370, ENGL 400, ENGL 450, ENGL 462, ENGL 463, and ENGL 465 Senior Project.

source_quote: As part of the Bachelor of Arts in English Language program, the student must study 18
answer: English majors take 18 credits of major electives (upper-level language, literature, or fiction/non-fiction writing), chosen with the advisor, preferably after departmental requirements. Recommended: ENGL 221, 223, 235, 252, 300, 320, 330, 365, 420, 460, and ENGL 497I.

answer: ENGL 497I Advanced Topics in English (3 credits) requires consent of the instructor.

answer: ENGL 222 Introduction to Language, 3(3,0), a mandatory English major course: theoretical and applied linguistics, levels of structure, language acquisition, variation, evolution and teaching.
